items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 40:1
items.html: The six upper [Sefirot] of Beriah are considered the aspect of a protrusion from Atzilut, because from their source they are the aspect of the two lower thirds of Tifferet, which are YESHSUT of the body, which did not receive the aspect of restriction because of themselves. For their essence is like Bina — that is, the light of Hassadim — which does not receive any diminution and restriction. Therefore, from this aspect the six upper [Sefirot] of Beriah are considered as if they are still the body of Atzilut; but because they are a root for ZON, they were therefore diminished and received upon themselves a restriction, and came out outside of Atzilut. And this exit is therefore discerned like a protrusion outward from her body because of the fetus, and not because of herself. See above, answer 34. (Item 83).
